Headquartered in San Francisco and led by Jas Khaira, the unit will concentrate on the infrastructure supporting AI, such as data centers and digital infrastructure, rather than just flashy AI companies. This move positions Blackstone to capitalize on the foundational elements driving AI innovation and follows a trend of private equity firms investing heavily in this space.

news_headlines.title: Why Viavi Solutions Stock Is Surging After a Big Earnings Beat
news_headlines.summary: Viavi Solutions Inc. experienced a significant stock surge of roughly 20% following a strong fiscal third-quarter earnings report that surpassed analyst expectations. The company observed robust demand from AI data centers and aerospace/defense clients, which helped offset softness in other telecom segments. Despite a drop in GAAP profit and negative cash flow for the quarter, the positive outlook for the upcoming fiscal fourth quarter and strategic acquisition of Spirent assets contributed to the optimistic market response.

news_headlines.title: From dust to 55C, HPE targets AI workloads in remote sites
news_headlines.summary: HPE has expanded its ProLiant edge portfolio with new ruggedized servers and chassis designed for AI and mission-critical workloads in harsh, distributed environments. These new solutions, including the HPE ProLiant Compute EL2000 chassis and enhanced HPE ProLiant DL145 Gen11 server, are built to withstand extreme temperatures, humidity, vibration, and electromagnetic interference, meeting stringent national security and telecom standards. The initiative aims to enable organizations to deploy AI inferencing and remote operations more efficiently and securely at the edge.

news_headlines.title: HPE introduces new ProLiant systems for distributed AI and edge computing
news_headlines.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) has expanded its ProLiant edge-computing portfolio with new systems designed for AI, analytics, and automation in rugged, space-constrained environments. The new ProLiant Compute EL2000 chassis, along with the EL220 and EL240 servers and enhancements to the ProLiant DL145 Gen11, aim to process data closer to where it's generated, outside traditional data centers. HPE emphasizes the importance of managing these distributed servers as a single global fleet using its iLO and Compute Ops Management software.

news_headlines.title: Two Weeks Ago I Asked If You Owned Enough Alphabet Stock. After Last Night's Earnings, You Still Don't.
news_headlines.summary: The author reiterates his conviction that investors do not own enough Alphabet (GOOGL) stock, especially after the company's strong Q1 2026 earnings report. Alphabet significantly beat EPS and revenue estimates, with Google Cloud revenue up 63% and a near-doubling of its backlog. The commercialization of Google's TPU chips, a direct move against Nvidia, further validated the author's previous AI infrastructure thesis, leading to immediate analyst target increases.

news_headlines.title: Goldman Sachs Group Stock (US38141G1040): Forecasts S&P 500 to Rise 6% in 2026
news_headlines.summary: Goldman Sachs Research anticipates the S&P 500 to reach 7,600 by the end of 2026, marking a 6% increase from April 24 levels, driven primarily by a 12% EPS growth and significant AI investments contributing 40% to earnings expansion. This outlook highlights optimism in U.S. equities, particularly due to the impact of AI on corporate earnings and substantial capital expenditures by cloud infrastructure companies. While positive, the forecast also acknowledges risks such as geopolitical tensions and potential challenges in AI buildout.

news_headlines.title: AVT Q1 Deep Dive: Asia and Data Center Demand Drive Outperformance Amid Inventory Tightness
news_headlines.summary: Avnet (AVT) reported impressive Q1 CY2026 results, surpassing revenue and EPS expectations, driven by strong demand in Asia, industrial, networking, and data center segments. The company's proactive inventory management and rising memory prices contributed to record sales, with optimistic guidance for Q2 reflecting continued market recovery and strategic investments in AI and data center projects. Management highlighted increased exposure to AI and data center projects and diligent cost control as key factors for future performance.

news_headlines.title: Arista Networks Stock (US0404131064): Q1 2026 Earnings Beat Expectations with 17% Revenue Growth
news_headlines.summary: Arista Networks announced strong first-quarter 2026 results, exceeding Wall Street expectations with $1.74 billion in revenue, a 17% year-over-year increase. This growth was primarily driven by surging demand for AI networking solutions and high-speed Ethernet switches. The company also surpassed earnings estimates with $1.65 per diluted share and maintained its full-year 2026 revenue guidance.
